judge: Native Codex subagent; requested GPT-6 Luna / Medium; effective runtime settings not introspectable; no paid OpenAI API.

family_own_stay.comparison: Both connect three bedrooms to the family need. U more clearly leaves timing to the customer; V responds to more customer-stated needs in turn 2. Difference small.

couple_home_office.comparison: V ties the room to the shared-space trade-off and explicitly preserves customer agency after conditional viewing interest.

genuine_purchase_interest.comparison: U follows the buyer's explicit plan and current-price prerequisites; V's second turn addresses the plan but not clearly the price request. Neither should book before the buyer is ready.

mapped_version_summary.materiality: Modest, specific improvement rather than a broad transformation. Candidate reduces unsolicited pricing support detours in the three opening turns, and better follows the active buyer's stated prerequisites. Per-scene scores vary; no claim that different customer reactions are causally attributable to the candidate.

separate_checks.buyer_visualization: Useful, grounded applications in both versions; mostly practical rather than vivid lifestyle imagery. Work-from-home and corridor comparison are most concrete.
separate_checks.persuasive_selling: Candidate average Product/Desire rises 8.00 to 8.33/10, but observed customer desire changes are modest and customer turns differ.
separate_checks.viewing: Invitations occur as ordinary replies. Customer responses show conditional interest only. No appointment agreement or formal handoff.
separate_checks.facts: No serious factual issue identified by Judge; all dated pricing is qualified. Exact room fit remains appropriately tied to the approved plan.
separate_checks.support: Support requests for plans, site access, and explicitly requested current pricing are appropriate. Candidate does not create a pricing request merely because the buyer says the starting range may be affordable.
separate_checks.limitations: Customer replies vary naturally across versions; only transcript behavior is compared, not causal customer response lift.
